messages:
elaine-sales: Hey team — prepping Halo POC. They want to run their LumenX-13b-slim weights on Dedicated with KMS + audit logs. Two asks: 1) compatibility check for tokenizer / KV-cache with our serving runtime, 2) ETA for onboarding + any enterprise blockers (security questionnaire attached). Model URL: https://s3.halo-models.com/lumenx/13b-slim.tar.gz. CC @raj-eng @maria-ml :eyes:
raj-eng: Got it. Quick Q — are the weights FP16 or already quantized?
elaine-sales: Halo says FP16 by default, but they plan a 4-bit quant variant for cost.
maria-ml: LumenX uses a custom byte-level tokenizer with extra merges. We'll likely need a tokenizer adapter; KV-cache layout looks OK if n_head matches our expectation. Quant path probably needs custom op mapping.
elaine-sales: I have the model config on the customer portal (emailed). Key fields: n_head=32, rotary=true, context=8192.
sam-sre: KMS + Private/Dedicated is fine from infra side. We do need the completed security questionnaire + SOC docs before onboarding. Olivia, can you confirm PII / logging constraints for Dedicated?
olivia-secu: PII logging policy: by default we don't persist inference inputs, only traces/errors. For Dedicated we offer configurable audit log retention (90d / 365d) as contract options. Halo wants HSM-backed keys — we support AWS KMS and external HSM integration but that requires enterprise legal + infra checklist.
raj-eng: I can run a runtime compatibility check using our inspect tool. Example command I will use:
```
ri model inspect --url https://s3.halo-models.com/lumenx/13b-slim.tar.gz --check-tokenizer --check-kv
```
I can kick this off tomorrow AM. If tokenizer mismatches, short mitigation: either (a) they supply tokenizer files, or (b) we add a lightweight adapter layer.
maria-ml: On quantization: 4-bit (NF4) often gives 2-3x cost savings but can increase generation variance. Recommend running our baseline eval (2k prompts) against customer prompts to measure quality delta. We can run that after tokenizer fix.
elaine-sales: Halo wants an internal POC in ~2 weeks. Can we hit that?
sam-sre: Two weeks is doable if: (1) model pulls cleanly and passes inspect, (2) tokenizer adapter is small or provided, (3) security questionnaire + contract addendum are signed. If any of those slip, add ~1 week.
raj-eng: Kicking off inspect now. ETA ~24h. Will post results and logs here.
deploy-bot: Model inspection job 88612 queued. Status: RUNNING. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
raj-eng: Inspect finished — tokenizer mismatch flagged: `vocab.json` uses merges format not recognized by our tokenizer registry. KV-cache layout PASSED. Logs: https://redwood.internal/jobs/88612/logs.
maria-ml: OK — I can prototype a tokenizer adapter (mapping merges -> merges2to1) and run the eval. After that, estimate ~48h to produce baseline reports and quant comparisons.
elaine-sales: I'll ask Halo for the quantized checkpoint and request signed sec questionnaire + SOC package today.
raj-eng: If they can't provide a quant checkpoint we can run quantization, but need access credentials and it's an extra run step (~4h). Also need to confirm their license for us to transform the model.
olivia-secu: Note for contract: addendum to cover model transformation and key custody. I'll draft language and share with legal.
elaine-sales: Great. Thanks — I'll update Halo and post back with docs. :thumbsup:
